text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALE - The U.N. has approved a recent sale of 100,000 tonnes of French wheat to Iraq under a U.N.-monitored oil-for-food pact, a French government source said. The approval, given by U.N. sanctions inspectors on Friday, brings to 300,000 tonnes the volume of wheat that has been sold to Iraq and subsequently cleared by the U.N., the source said.

CORN TENDER - State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp will tender on Wednesday for a shipment of 10,000 tonnes of U.S. corn, traders said. The tender will specify that sellers have the optin for delivery dates, which can be any 20-day window in June.
- The CCC said it would seek up to 4,620 tonnes of No. 2 or better yellow corn under its export program for Guatemala. Offers were due on March 19 and shipment was slated for April 3-27.

VEGOIL TENDER - Egypt's Holding Company for Food Industries said Monday it was seeking up to 45,000 tonnes of assorted vegetable oils for delivery in May 1997. The deadline for all bids was on April 2.
WHEAT TENDERS - News was awaited on Iraq's tender for 50,000 tonnes U.S. hard red winter wheat slated for May delivery, exporters said.
- The CCC on March 18 seeks up to 25,550 tonnes of wheat for donation to Jordan and Yemen for April 1-25.
- Algeria on Monday tendered for 75,000 tonnes of optional-origin milling wheat for shipment in April and May.

BARLEY TENDER - The South African Wheat Board said Friday it was offering 25,150 tonnes of feed grade barley for export sale not later than April 30. The board said the barley was five percent more or less, seller's option.
- Iran will tender for the import of 50,000 tonnes of optional-origin feed barley on March 17, European grain traders said on Thursday. The barley is for shipment in May.

RICE TENDER - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs has issued an international tender to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for shipment between April 20 and May 20, a company spokesman said. April 8 is the final date for bids and result will be announced on April 16.

- Costa Rica on March 19 will seek a total of 30,000 tonnes optional origin rough rice which would likely be from the United States or Argentina, U.S. exporters and trade sources said. One U.S. exporter said he believed the paddy rice was slated for June arrival while another said it was set for May.
RAPESEED MEAL/WHEATBRAN PELLET TENDERS - South Korea feed milling companies have invited tenders for 26,500 tonnes of rapeseed meal and 36,000 tonnes of wheatbran pellet on Tuesday, traders said.

MARKET TALK - More than 170,000 tonnes of wheat are due to arrive in Iraq in late March or early April, Iraqi and U.N. sources said. The wheat, from Australia and France, was part of an influx of supplies Iraq purchased under an oil-for-food deal with the U.N.

... Saudi Arabia has signed a 130 million riyal ($34.6 million) deal to purchase about 60,000 tonnes of rice from the United States and India to meet increasing demand, a Saudi newspaper said on Saturday.
... South Korea buyers plan to pick up more Chinese corn for August/September shipment while interest in U.S.-origin has dried up due to high Chicago futures prices, traders said.
... Sri Lanka will not import rice until August as the current crop has been satisfactory, an official of the agriculture ministry told Reuters on Monday.
